AddFaceVideoTemplate.description:
## Feature Description  
The Add Face Video Template feature allows you to use a video containing human faces that has passed content moderation as a template for the face fusion in video feature.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or other issues related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete your registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure that you have activated the [Video Production Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videoenhan). If not, [activate it immediately](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videoenhan_public_cn#/open).  
><notice>  
This feature is available only to users who have completed enterprise verification. For more information about identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428525.html).  
></notice>

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you must grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this feature using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videoenhan/2020-03-20/AddFaceVideoTemplate?lang=JAVA), where you can view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "video production (videoenhan)".  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Add Face Video Template Sample Code](~~602556~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  

- **Video formats**: MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, FLV, TS, MPG.  
- **Video resolution**: From 320×320 pixels to 1920×1920 pixels.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 120 MB.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  
- Each user can upload up to 3000 video templates.  
- For videos containing multiple faces, the number of unique person IDs in a single video must not exceed 6. If more than 6 face IDs are detected, the system returns the top 6 most frequently appearing persons.  
- Only static (constant) frame rate videos are supported; dynamic (variable) frame rate videos are not supported.

## Response Parameter Description  
- During template addition, the system automatically performs filtering checks for pornography and politically sensitive content. Templates that fail these checks cannot be added successfully.  
- In multi-person videos with multiple face IDs, the system returns results sorted by the duration each face appears.

## Video Frame Quality Recommendations  
- Ensure that faces in the image are clear. The recommended minimum face size is 64×64 pixels, and the face area should not exceed two-thirds of the entire image.  
- It is recommended that facial features be fully visible without significant occlusion. The face fusion algorithm supports slight head rotation; optimal results are achieved when the rotation angle does not exceed 30 degrees.  
- In multi-face video scenarios, the system automatically identifies different person IDs throughout the video. To ensure accurate identification, avoid large head rotations or significant occlusions in the video.

![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/jris/MergeImageFacetuijian.png" width="300)

## Invocation Procedure  
This is an asynchronous feature and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the **AddFaceVideoTemplate** API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~159423~~) API to query the result using the job ID. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. Do not resubmit the same job while it is still processing.

EnhancePortraitVideo.description:
## Feature Description  
The video portrait enhancement capability is based on the GPEN portrait enhancement model. It enhances facial clarity in videos, significantly enriching facial details and texture. Additionally, by leveraging a face quality assessment algorithm and dynamically adjusting the fusion coefficient, it ensures that enhanced faces remain natural and realistic.

>- You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This capability is available for a complete free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?tagName=videoenhan&children=EnhancePortraitVideo) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase the service online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence API capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API support team.

## Common Scenarios  

- Enhancing and restoring faces in old or low-quality videos.  
- Improving the definition of captured footage for ultra-high definition video production.

## Key Advantages

GenerateVideo.description:
## Feature Description  
The general video generation capability can intelligently generate short marketing videos based on the input source video. It supports mixed processing of materials such as images, videos, and audio, and allows overlaying post-processing effects like transitions and special effects. You can select either the apparel scenario (default) or the general scenario for the input video. The system analyzes people and objects in the video to generate a storyline that organizes the sequence of materials. Alternatively, you can force the system to produce the video scene strictly according to the input material order by configuring input parameters.

The general video generation capability includes the following features:  
- **Input file types**: Supports one or more of the following: video, audio, and image.  
- **Output video pacing**: Options include normal (default), fast, and slow.  
- **Transition style selection**: Offers 15 styles in total. If no style is specified, a random style is applied. Currently supported transition styles include: basic (none), slow (relaxed), fast (dynamic), normal (natural), ink (ink wash painting), glitch (glitch effect), shift (switch), mosaic (mosaic), shutter (venetian blind), zoom (scaling), mask (masking), brush (brush stroke), wind (wind dance), and smog (smoke).  
- **Intelligent effects**: Currently supports audio-visual filter interaction and static-to-dynamic effects, which are added by default.  
- **Dynamic collage effect**: Allows displaying multiple video or image materials within a single shot using a collage layout. This effect is not added by default.

MergeVideoFace.title: Video Face Fusion
MergeVideoFace.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the MergeVideoFace operation for video face fusion.
MergeVideoFace.description:
## Feature Description  
Under the premise of User Authorization, the general video face fusion feature can detect the largest face in a video and fuse it with the facial features of another person, achieving a realistic face-swapping effect.  
General video face fusion requires only one input image containing the face to be fused and a video segment. The service then seamlessly blends the face from the image into the video.  

Scenarios:  
- Each synthesis is completed independently, without using a common template.  
- Only supports scenarios where the video contains a single face.  

For multi-person scenarios or videos with a fixed number of templates, see [Template-based Video Face Fusion](~~467950~~) (MergeVideoModelFace).  
To ensure the safety and legality of generated content, do not use images or videos of public figures or those containing Sensitive Information for fusion. Additionally, this service adds a **Generated by AI** watermark in the lower-left corner of the synthesized result, as shown in the figure below.  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230213/ezcg/MergeVideoModelFace.png)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=videoenhan&children=MergeVideoFace) for an intuitive hands-on experience and online Purchase.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, API usage, or other issues related to Visual Intelligence API capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  
- **Post-production for film and television**: During post-production, if actor replacement is required for any reason, video face fusion technology can process previously shot Material to make characters in the original footage appear as if performed by a new actor, significantly reducing reshoot costs for production companies.  
- **Entertaining short video creation**: Users can fuse their own faces with those of authorized characters in legal videos to generate fun and engaging content.  

## Key Advantages  
- **High fidelity and natural appearance**: The fused face retains the visual identity features of the source face while blending naturally into the target face without a sense of incongruity.  
- **Consistent expressions and skin tone**: The fused face maximally preserves the original facial expressions and skin tone consistency of the target face.  
- **Support for complex face angles**: Supports template faces rotated up to a certain angle, producing realistic and stable fusion results.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated the [Video Enhancement service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videoenhan). If not yet activated, [activate now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videoenhan_public_cn#/open).  

><notice>Users who activate this capability on or after July 17, 2024, can invoke it directly without submitting a request.  
Users who activated the service before July 17, 2024, must contact us via DingTalk group (23109592) to be added to the whitelist before invoking the service.  
></notice>  

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videoenhan/2020-03-20/MergeVideoFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22VideoURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fvideoenhan%2FMergeVideoFace%2FMergeVideoFace1.mp4%22%2C%22ReferenceURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fvideoenhan%2FMergeVideoFace%2FMergeVideoFace-pic1.png%22%2C%22PostURL%22%3A%22%20%22%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug online, view complete Sample Code and SDK Dependency information, and download the full project.  
5. **Developer integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "videoenhan" (Video Enhancement).  
   - Modify the provided Sample Code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this capability, see [Video Face Fusion Sample Code](~~602481~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this capability include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Video formats**: MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, FLV, TS, MPG.  
- **Video resolution**: Greater than 360 × 360 pixels and less than 1920 × 1920 pixels.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 120 MB.  
- **Image formats**: JPEG, JPG, PNG.  
- **Image resolution**: At least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 4000 × 4000 pixels.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 20 MB.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  
- **Video frame rate**: Only Static (constant) frame rate videos are supported; Dynamic (variable) frame rate videos are not supported.  
- **Video duration**: No longer than 300 seconds. For videos longer than 300 seconds, use the [Template-based Video Face Fusion](~~467950~~) API.  

## Image Quality Recommendations  

- Ensure the face in the image is clear. The face size should be at least 64 × 64 pixels, and the face area should not exceed two-thirds of the entire image.  
- It is recommended that the facial features in the image be fully visible with no significant occlusion. The face fusion algorithm supports faces rotated up to a certain angle, with optimal results achieved when the rotation angle does not exceed 30 degrees.  
- It is recommended that the input image contain only one face. If multiple faces are present, the largest face in the image will be selected by default for fusion.  

Recommended image example:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/jris/MergeImageFacetuijian.png)  

Not recommended image example:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/rkbx/MergeImageFacebutuijian.png)  

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps:  
1. Call the MergeVideoFace API to submit a Job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a Job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the Job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still processing, wait a short time before querying again. Do not resubmit the same task while it is still being processed.

MergeVideoModelFace.title: Template-based Video Face Fusion
MergeVideoModelFace.description:
## Feature Description  
With user authorization, Video Face Fusion precisely detects faces in a video and seamlessly blends the user-uploaded target face image with another person's facial appearance in the video, achieving a realistic face-swapping effect.  

Template-based Video Face Fusion uses a pre-uploaded and created template. By providing a single face image for fusion, this method integrates the provided face into a specified template video. To use this approach, you must first create a template video (via AddFaceVideoTemplate). This method offers higher processing efficiency compared to the general Video Face Fusion approach.  

Scenarios:  
- Scenarios involving a fixed number of template videos for fusion.  
- Supports both single-face and multi-face scenarios within a video, including selective face swapping and multi-face fusion.  

To ensure the safety and legality of generated content, do not use images or videos of public figures or those containing Sensitive Information for fusion. Additionally, all synthesized results will include a **Generated by AI** watermark in the bottom-left corner, as shown below:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230213/ezcg/MergeVideoModelFace.png)  

> - You can obtain live assistance via [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  
- **Post-production in film and television**: When actors need to be replaced during post-production due to certain constraints, Video Face Fusion can process previously shot footage so that characters in the original video appear as if performed by new actors, significantly reducing reshoot costs for production studios.  
- **Entertaining short video creation**: Users can blend their own face with authorized faces from legal videos to generate fun and engaging content.  
- **Virtual try-on**: In scenarios such as wedding photography, ethnic costumes, Hanfu, or makeup simulation, Video Face Fusion enables virtual clothing trials through facial integration.  
- **E-commerce digital human live streaming**: In live-streaming sales scenarios,网红 face IDs can be swapped to enable digital human live selling or virtual human face replacement.  

## Key Advantages  
- **High fidelity and natural blending**: The fused face retains the visual identity features of the source face while integrating naturally into the target face without any sense of incongruity.  
- **Consistent expression and skin tone**: The fused face preserves the original facial expressions and maintains consistent skin tone with the target face.  
- **Support for complex face angles**: Supports templates where the face is tilted at a certain angle, producing realistic and stable fusion results.  
- **Multi-face selective swapping**: Supports videos containing multiple faces, allowing each face to be fused with a different user-provided face. Applicable in interactive multi-person scenarios such as family portraits, wedding photography, and multi-character creative content.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Sign Up Now** in the top-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Enable the service**: Ensure you have enabled the [Video Enhancement Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videoenhan). If not yet enabled, [activate it immediately](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videoenhan_public_cn#/open). This feature is only available to users who have completed enterprise verification. For instructions on identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428525.html).  

><notice>Users who enable this capability on or after July 17, 2024, can invoke it directly without submitting an application.  
Users who enabled this service before July 17, 2024, must contact us via DingTalk group (23109592) to be added to the whitelist before invoking the service.  
></notice>  

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videoenhan/2020-03-20/MergeVideoModelFace?lang=JAVA) to debug online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Prerequisites**: First, call the [AddFaceVideoTemplate](~~468904~~) API to add a video template and obtain a Template ID (`TemplateId`). Then, use this `TemplateId` along with the face image to be fused when making your request.  
6. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the Video Enhancement (`videoenhan`) category.  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the provided Sample Code.  
7. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Template Video Face Fusion Sample Code](~~602484~~).  
8. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Image format**: JPEG, JPG, PNG.  
- **Image resolution**: Between 128×128 pixels and 4000×4000 pixels (inclusive).  
- **Image size**: No larger than 20 MB.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  

## Input Parameter Description  
**MergeInfos** specifies the fusion parameters, including face information from the template video and the user-provided face image to be fused (**required when TemplateId corresponds to multiple faces**).  
- **MergeInfos** is used only in multi-face video scenarios. Ensure that when adding the template, the **VideoScene** parameter was set to `multi`. The **TemplateFaceID** values provided must exactly match those returned in **FaceInfos** during template creation.  
- If both **FaceImageURL** and **MergeInfos** are provided, the system determines whether the template is single-face or multi-face based on **TemplateId**, and ignores the other input parameter accordingly.  

## Image Quality Recommendations  
- Ensure the face in the image is clear. The face should be at least 64×64 pixels in size, and the face region should not exceed two-thirds of the entire image area.  
- The facial features should be fully visible without significant occlusion. The face fusion algorithm supports faces tilted at an angle; optimal results are achieved when the tilt does not exceed 30 degrees.  
- In multi-face video scenarios, the system automatically identifies distinct person IDs throughout the video. Avoid large head rotations or significant occlusions in the video, as these may lead to inaccurate person ID detection.  

Recommended image examples:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/jris/MergeImageFacetuijian.png)  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230609/otnv/MergeVideoModelFacetuijian.png)  

Not recommended image examples:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/rkbx/MergeImageFacebutuijian.png)  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230609/jcgb/MergeVideoModelFacebutuijian.png)  

## Invocation Steps  
This is an asynchronous API and requires two steps:  
1. Call the `MergeVideoModelFace` API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you will receive a Job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~159423~~) API to query the result using the Job ID. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. Avoid resubmitting the same job while it is still in progress.  

## Billing Information  
For details on the metering method and pricing of Template Video Face Fusion, see [Billing Introduction](~~202487~~).

## Common Scenarios

- **Old video restoration**: Using a deep learning-based video super resolution algorithm, low-resolution videos can be enhanced and converted into high-resolution videos.  
- **Online video playback**: Transmit low-resolution videos under low-bandwidth conditions, then use the video super resolution algorithm to revert them to high-resolution videos on the playback client.

## Key Advantages

- Leverages deep learning algorithms to generate more realistic video details.  
- Outputs videos at twice the original resolution, significantly increasing visual clarity.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Video Enhancement service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videoenhan). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videoenhan_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For detailed steps, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this feature using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videoenhan/2020-03-20/SuperResolveVideo?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22VideoUrl%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fvideoenhan%2FSuperResolveVideo%2FSuperResolveVideo1.mp4%22%2C%22BitRate%22%3A5%7D&tab=DEMO). View complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "videoenhan" (Video Enhancement).  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this feature, see [Video Ultra HD Sample Code](~~602945~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this feature include:

   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions

- **Video formats**: MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, FLV, TS, MPG, MXF.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 1 GB.  
- **Video resolution**: Greater than 360×360 pixels and less than 1920×1080 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of Video Ultra HD, see [Billing Introduction](~~202487~~).

## Invocation Steps  
This feature is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the `SuperResolveVideo` API to submit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [`GetAsyncJobResult`](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the job execution status and result. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. We recommend not resubmitting the same job while it is still running.
